title: RDL atom interchange format
description: Output produced by every front-end adapter and consumed by shared_backend/rdl_backend.py. The shared backend MUST be the only thing that returns sat/unsat/unknown. Adapters MUST NOT call any built-in solver.

status.description: ok: rdl atoms successfully extracted; unsupported: input contains constructs the adapter intentionally rejects (e.g. non-conjunctive Boolean structure for P0); error: adapter crashed or input could not be parsed

frontend.description: Identifier for the front-end this adapter wraps, e.g. somtparser, z3_cpp, cvc5_cpp, smt_switch, pysmt, antlr4, jsmtlib

mode.description: P0 always uses conjunction. P1 (reserved) will use boolean with a CNF and an atom map

variables.description: Includes the special node ZERO when unary bounds are present

constraints.description: Each entry is x - y (op) bound where op is < or <=. Other forms are normalized: >= and > are flipped, = is split into two entries. Strict <, > and the strict half of equality become strict=true.

lhs.description: Variable name on the positive side; ZERO is allowed for unary bounds

rhs.description: Variable name on the negative side; ZERO is allowed for unary bounds

bound.description: String parsable by Python fractions.Fraction, e.g. '3', '-2', '7/2', '3.5'

source.description: Optional: original SMT-LIB s-expression for debugging

cnf.description: Reserved for P1: list of clauses, each clause is a list of nonzero ints (positive => atom id, negative => negated atom id)

atoms.description: Reserved for P1: maps positive atom id (as string) to a constraint object

reason.description: Required when status is unsupported or error
